videos.title: Epidemiology
videos.name: Epidemiology
videos.overview: Pierce and a few other Greendale students ingest a biohazard substance at the school Halloween Party, causing them to exhibit flu-like symptoms and begin turning into zombies. It is up to the rest of the gang to save themselves and the school when Dean Pelton locks them in with the zombie-infected student body.

videos.title: Paranormal Parentage
videos.name: Paranormal Parentage
videos.overview: On Halloween, Pierce accidentally locks himself in his panic room, forcing the gang to search through his house to find the code that unlocks the door.
